notes.title: The Ancients is OUT NOW (Early Access!)
notes.notes:
Gather 'round the campfire, Tribe!

[h1]Turn-based prehistoric survival strategy, The Ancients, is OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS![/h1]

[previewyoutube=WOV-mHjClDA;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been quite the journey getting here -- from our Kickstarter to this exciting Early Access launch (and beyond) -- and we couldn't have done it without your support. Thank you so much for helping us get here; we are touched by the enthusiasm and patience you've shown us throughout the development period.

Although this information can be found on the game's store page, we'd like to take the time to post it here to remind players our plans for early access:

Why Early Access?
“Early access allows us to get a better feel on player feedback, both in terms of balancing, changes to mechanics, or features that would help with the overall quality of life in the game and its campaign and sandbox experiences. With our small team, early access also helps us prioritize certain content in the game and better track down bugs.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“8 - 12 months”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“We plan to add new research tech, biomes, maps, craftables, resources, and animals. We will also be adding and removing content according to player feedback.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?
“The game mechanics are complete. Bugs exist and the game is not fully polished. Content is not fully finished. As mentioned, we plan to add new research tech, biomes, maps, craftables, resources, and animals.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
“The game will remain the same price during and after early access. We have no plans to change the price.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
“Community feedback is an important part of our development process. We regularly incorporate feedback both from the Steam discussion and our Discord to ensure that players are getting the best possible experience.”

If you have any questions or found a bug (or just want to say hi!), feel free to post them here in the discussions or [url=https://discord.gg/GD8j6G8Er6]join our Discord[/url]. After all, when you're here, you're tribe!

Thanks again for all the support -- see you in The Ancients!

notes.title: The Ancients Early Access Release Date is Here!!!
notes.notes:
Grab your spears, Tribe!

[h1]Turn-based prehistoric survival strategy, The Ancients, will be releasing to Early Access June 5![/h1]

The Ancients takes the core mechanics of real-time prehistorical survival strategy, Dawn of Man, and brings it to a unique turn-based experience, complete with deep skill tree, diverse wildlife, real Ice Age biomes and increasingly challenging migration routes to keep your survival skills honed.

Check out the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=WOV-mHjClDA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Some Highlights:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A complete tutorial, campaign mode and procedurally generated sandbox mode for infinite replayability are available from Day 1 in the Early Access release
[*] 60+ historically accurate resources & animals to discover, gather & hunt
[*] 75+ research nodes and society paths to boost replayability and diversify your approach to managing your tribe & surviving the harsh Ice Age environments
[*] Needs management mechanics will be familiar to survival fans 
[*] Society management mechanics are new and unique to the genre
[/list]

[h2]Quick Facts:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Early Access Release Date: June 5, 2024
[*] Developer: Small Turkey-based indie studio GorillaSoftworks
[*] Publisher: Camlann Games (Underspace, Ascent of Ashes)
[*] Price: $19.99 (with a 10% launch discount)
[*] Game Modes: Single Player (Campaign Mode & procedurally generated Sandbox Mode)
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/sKsDGCW6nr
[/list]

See you next month, Tribe!!!

notes.title: Progress as of February 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Tribesmen! As you may know, we have had a successful Kickstarter campaign near the end of 2022. We have managed to reach our initial goal and even go above it. We would first like to thank everyone in our community, whether you have pledged or not, for supporting us in our journey.

[h3][b]So, what have we been up to?[/b][/h3]

We have been working diligently on The Ancients to bring you the best game possible. Our team of developers have been pouring their hearts and souls into making sure that our game meets your expectations. Through our hard work, we are confident that you will be pleased with the end result when The Ancients is fully playable and ready for release.

[h3][b]To be more specific:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Rivers system has been implemented.
[*] Africa, Mesopotamia, and Europe maps are ready now!
[*] Animals and vegetation for the three levels are modeled and added to the game.
[*] Tribe scenes for Africa, Mesopotamia, and Europe have been designed. 
[*] Different objectives for the three maps have been designed and implemented.
[*] More animals and vegetables have been added.
[*] Craft system updated.
[*] 20+ more events have been added.
[*] Historical Landmarks for the maps have been added.
[*] A large number of bug fixes have been implemented.
[*] The transition between levels and map selection systems have been implemented.
[*] Some of the Indian subcontinent animals have been modeled and added.
[/list]


Again, we would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to our community for your continued support. We are incredibly grateful for the outpouring of enthusiasm and positivity that has allowed us to progress and grow. We are looking forward to what comes next and are eager to continue working on The Ancients as we get ready for a 2023 release.

Join our Discord to stay in the loop about future updates!

notes.title: The Ancients is Live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theancients/the-ancients-first-sparks-of-civilization][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41391669/38da6f8f00a8d01bfff647e5951d716c5fb28319.png[/img][/url]

As the Gorilla Softworks team, we have worked very hard on making [i]The Ancients[/i] the best it can be. But there comes a time in every development adventure where funding becomes as important as the passion of the developers. And that time has come for [i]The Ancients[/i] as well. Our team wants to release [i]The Ancients[/i] in its most feature-rich state, so we have decided on launching a Kickstarter campaign and reach our goals with the aid of our community. You can click [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theancients/the-ancients-first-sparks-of-civilization]here [/url][/b]to visit our Kickstarter page, which we are incredibly excited about.

[b]At the moment, we have three stretch goals that go up to 15.000$. Our stretch goals are as follows:[/b]

-	At 8.000$, we are planning to add dynamic weather effects to each biome that ranges from rainbows to typhoons. 
-	At 10.000$, our plan is to hire additional 3D artists to work on enhancing the graphical experience of [i]The Ancients[/i]. 
-	At 15.000$, we will hold a community poll to decide on new biomes to be added to the ever-expanding world of [i]The Ancients[/i].

[b]These stretch goals are not final and new goals will be added as the campaign continues.[/b]

If you would like to support us in reaching these goals, you can choose between a number of pledge options and be rewarded accordingly. And while you are choosing which tier to contribute to, keep in mind our Early Bird discount (down to 119$ from 149$) we have on the highest tier. With higher tiers of pledges getting all the rewards of their lower tiers, our pledge rewards are as follows:

-	3$ or more gives you access to the Pledge Manager and gain the amount you have spent as credit on the manager.

-	24$ or more gives you access to a digital downloadable copy of [i]The Ancients[/i] on Steam for the full release. You also gain access to digital wallpapers and developer polls that will shape the future of the game. Your name will also be featured in the credits of [i]The Ancients[/i].

-	79$ or more gets you the ultimate digital tier for this Kickstarter campaign. In addition to the rewards from the previous tier, you also gain access to the digital artbook and Kickstarter exclusive Tribe and UI Design. 

-	149$ or more is the ultimate package for this Kickstarter campaign. With this tier, you will also be rewarded with exclusive rewards that won’t ever be available again. This tier includes but is not limited to: a hardcover print of the artbook, the privilege of naming a character in the game, and top-quality miniatures.

Again, we are extraordinarily proud to have come thus far and excited to be taking the next step in our development in the form of our Kickstarter campaign. You can check out the campaign by clicking [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theancients/the-ancients-first-sparks-of-civilization]here[/url][/b]. Thank you all for being there for the GorillaSoftworks team and supporting the development of our game, [i]The Ancients[/i].

notes.title: The Ancients - Development Letter #1
notes.notes:
Dear Player,
Hope you’re doing well. It has not been long since we invented writing. We can't say it went very well after that. But here we are, writing our first development letter to you! We were warned to write an actual devlog but that didn't make us feel sincere.

It seems like a long time since the first game idea came up, but it's been nearly a year since we started developing the game “digitally”. Since then, we have worked day and night to give the player the best experience. Now, with our team of three people, we are counting the days until The Ancients’ release.

Inscriptions on cave walls have shown us how intelligible simplicity can be, so we want to start with the simplest question: [b]What is The Ancients?[/b]

The Ancients is a t[b]urn-based survival/strategy game[/b] addressing dark ages of humanity. You can convert cavemen into civilized people; explore Ice Age World with only feet, like your ancestors did. Meanwhile, you can create your own culture and community to survive.

We are focusing on creating human culture and making decisions about that culture. We want to not only survive, but also blend these elements with creating culture and offer you a unique experience.

One of the most important features we offer is tribe management. Create policies for your tribe, whether you want to be dictatorial or democratic, violent or peaceful, equal or hierarchical. Each selection will assist you in dealing with problems in its own unique way.

“Less text, more playability” is very significant to us.We try to use a simple interface as much as possible in The Ancients to make the numbers more understandable.

Unlike other games, The Ancients pushes players to wander around and explore constantly. Also we offer you the opportunity to experience a new era with the time zone we use in the game.


To sum up, we intend to talk with you more frequently now that we have met. We will keep you informed of the development phase of the Ancients with our regular letters. Besides, wouldn't it be nice if we had a little chat once in a while?

We are very pleased to meet you.

Sincerely,
The Ancients Game Dev
